protocol.prediction_time: scheduled start − 30 min; inputs: games on earlier dates only

baselines.elo: FiveThirtyEight NHL Elo form (MOV multiplier 0.6686·ln(MOV)+0.8048), K/HFA/reversion tuned on the selection window
baselines.goals_only: the same GLM on goals ratings and rest only

data.source: hockey/data/team_games (sportsdataverse fastRhockey, from the NHL public game feeds)
data.license: sportsdataverse/fastRhockey-nhl-data and -raw are MIT-licensed repositories; the game data inside them is compiled from the NHL's public game feeds and remains the NHL's. NHL.com terms restrict commercial use of its content: the owner must review this before NHL output is sold in a paid tier. Attribution is printed on every NHL artifact.

temporal.revisions: the history was retrieved after the fact; later source corrections may be present, so this is a retrospective test, not a certified point-in-time one

lineups.source: per-game skater box scores (sportsdataverse fastRhockey skater_box, from the NHL game feeds)
lineups.method: player value = recent TOI per game (last 20 of his games, any team) shrunk toward 10 min with 3 games of prior; lineup value = sum over the dressed skaters; feature = ln(lineup value / the team's mean over its last 10 games, re-valued today). Projected = the previous game's lineup; confirmed = the lineup that dressed.
lineups.assumption: the dressed lineup is known at warmups, about 30 minutes before puck drop (the prediction time). No injury report is used; nothing about the game itself enters its own snapshot.
lineups.added: the three lineup candidates were declared on 2026-10-13, after the confirmation window had been read for the original five; the selection rule is unchanged.

leakage.basis: inputs dated by assumed_available_at (scheduled start + 4 h); the source never recorded when it first published each game

selection.rule: lowest selection-window moneyline log loss; a challenger must beat the incumbent by >= 0.001

moneyline.market_reason: no licensed archive of timestamped NHL closing prices is on file (hockey/market/closing/); until one is, no NHL price is called an edge

caveats: Retrospective, not point-in-time certified: every input row was retrieved after the fact, its first-publication time is unknown, and the walk-forward assumes a game's facts were available four hours after its scheduled start.
Outcome validation only: no licensed archive of NHL closing prices is available to this build, so the model has NOT been compared with the market. Beating Elo is not beating a sportsbook.

The xG model is fitted walk-forward on seasons before each season it scores; from 2022-23 the source changed how it records shot locations and the xG model is less well calibrated on those seasons (hockey/xg/report.json).
Confirmed-goalie results assume the starter is known 30 minutes before puck drop; prices posted earlier use the projected starter.
Playoff games are included and use sudden-death overtime; they are a small share of every window.
